title: IT Risk & Audit Professional
description:
Are you our new colleague?

We’re looking for a IT risk & audit professional at Randstad Global

Sao Paolo, Brazil, hybrid, fulltime


BR&AF

The business risk and audit function (BR&AF) provides assurance and recommendations to the Executive Board and the Audit Committee on Randstad Group’s (risk) management, control and governance practices. Therefore the department facilitates in setting governance standards. It provides advice on internal control improvements, it conducts audits, special investigations and assignments worldwide on request of the Executive Board and Audit Committee. BR&AF’s responsibility includes the quarterly reporting based on: the risk and internal control self assessments, audit results, discussions on internal control weaknesses and analysis of the key risks reported throughout the company's management structure. This also substantiates the Group’s in-control statements.


The global function consists of team members operating through hubs spread over 4 continents. The team is organized in a matrix consisting of control & audit focus teams on business and functional areas (e.g. digital, talent, client, back office & shared service centers and fraud & forensics) and partners that are the linking pin to operating units (business risk & audit partners) with a global view. A support group is set up for professional practice, learning & development, quality improvement & methods, analytics and PMO.

Representatives of the different groups (Focus teams, BR&A Partners and support group) form the BR&AF core management team that reports to the Managing Director BR&AF.


how you will contribute

As IT auditor you are part of the, Business Risk & Audit - IT focus team and are going to:

  • perform and assist internal audit projects and internal control evaluation related to 'digital' processes, such as general IT processes, IT program & project management, 3rd party assurance, security, business IT (automated) controls, RPA, AI and BCP.
  • together with other team members you coordinate, execute and report on the outcomes of risk management, internal control and internal audit in close collaboration with other involved and impacted functions within the group, such as IT and global IT program organizations
  • provide coaching & development for your team members with respect to IT general controls, application controls and other technical expertise's required within Risk & Audit.
  • support the planning, execution and reporting of the risk, internal control and internal audit activities in your domain to make impact. You know your impact is there when management follows-up on your reports by implementing operational and control improvements.


what you will be doing

  • participate in risk assessments and assist in audit planning and scoping, such as: IT general controls, automated controls, RPA and IT projects.
  • perform IT controls/process audits on scope elements.
  • lead and execute audits, for technical domains, including: physical security, ethical hacking and technical validation of controls on multiple OSI layers.
  • support combined comfort analyses on maturity of IT general controls relevant domains (combining audit insights with other sources of data such as internal control projects, management controls self-assessment and developments within the company)
  • participate and lead audit interviews, accountable to prepare audit workpapers and reporting, as well as assist in drafting audit findings and recommendations for management based on identified control weaknesses or process improvements.
  • support and monitor the follow-up implementation of corrective actions by management.
  • act as a resource for colleagues with less expertise.


who will you work with

  • Partners/communities within the IT operations and projects space
  • IT security, data protection, information security and business continuity communities within the Randstad organization.
  • Business risk & audit partners
  • IT & digital leadership
  • External co-source partners
  • BR &A F stakeholders/clients within the business including local MT's, process and control owners


what you will bring

Your in depth understanding and experience with general IT management processes, business enabling through it (automated controls, RPA and IA) combined with risk & audit skills are well developed. As a critical challenger to management you strike the right tone. You have a keen interest in enabling an effective balance in managing IT effectively while enabling the business to operate optimally leveraging IT. You have a sharp eye for improvements strengthening management controls structurally in the context of what works best within the company setting and not taking it from a theoretical perspective.

You:

  • have minimum 5 to 8 years of relevant experience
  • have at minimum a bachelor degree in IT, business or economics.
  • are qualified as IT auditor (e.g. CISA, RE or equivalent).

You work and act in a way that:

  • creates clarity - showing line of sight (analytical skills): you collect and analyze data to solve problems, make decisions and advice within your professional boundaries.
  • collaborates, reaches out (organizational sensitivity): maneuvering comfortably through complex policy, process and people-related organizational dynamics recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization
  • ensures the business, thus: align, improve, execute and promote systems and work processes that support the business in achieving its goals and complies with internal and external standards and regulatory requirements.
  • co-drives the business, thus: provide insights into drivers for value creation and act as business partner in making decisions that enhance performance.
  • applies outside- in thinking (curiosity), with: unrest to push the boundary, eagerness, examination of new possibilities by investigating and asking questions, exploring and/or discovering new possibilities and assuming something better is still out there. You are comfortable leading what isn’t understood.


As IT auditor you:

  • have a strong independent mindset
  • are experienced in international stakeholder management & change
  • are an innovative thinker that challenges the status quo

have an agile and flexible working style and passion for on the job coaching and development


Your competences demonstrates you can:

  • support the development of an audit universe and audit approaches on IT risks and opportunities, as well as assist in building cyber assurance practices within Randstad.
  • prepare audit plannings and scoping on identified (cyber) risks & opportunities.
  • lead and execute internal audits/review for operational business processes, with focus on cyber and give guidance and/or instructions to junior staff in audit projects.
  • report and communicate audit findings at the right tone to make impact and provide recommendations for improvements.


Your Business English is at level BEC B1/B2 or higher.

As the standard office locations for the BR&AF team are organized in hubs, like in the country mentioned, it is relevant, as part of the job, you are willing to travel. Travelling is estimated to be about 20% to 30% of the job.


your competencies

Within Randstad we defined the following Leadership competencies:

  • delighting people: connect people (client, talent, employee, society), building strong client relationships and delivering client-centric solutions.
  • performing today: resourcefulness securing and developing resources effectively and efficiently.
  • leading change: manages ambiguity operating effectively, even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.
  • securing the future: drives vision and purpose painting a compelling picture of the vision and strategy that motivates others into action.
  • strategic mindset: seeing ahead to future possibilities and translating them into breakthrough strategies
  • creating clarity - showing line of sight: making sense of complex, high quantity and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems and provides direction, is delegating and removing obstacles to get work done
  • courage to challenge: shows courage and confidence to speak up skillfully, challenging others even when they are confronted with resistance or unfamiliar circumstances


what’s in it for you

We put people at the heart of everything we do. Our employment conditions reflect this and are in accordance with the applicable (local) Randstad employment policies and related personnel guide.

We want our teams and talent to reflect the rich diversity of the societies we serve. We thrive for an environment of belonging, safety and confidence. So everyone can bring their whole selves to work and flourish. Learn more about equity, diversity, inclusion and belonging at randstad here .

  • Garantir que todos os projetos sejam executados conforme o planejamento, dentro dos prazos e orçamento estabelecidos;
  • Assegurar a qualidade dos projetos, seguindo as normas e regulamentos do setor naval;
  • Coordenar com outras áreas da empresa para garantir a integração e eficiência dos projetos;
  • Realizar análises técnicas e fornecer soluções inovadoras para desafios de engenharia;
  • Supervisionar a execução dos projetos, garantindo a conformidade com os requisitos técnicos e operacionais;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e tecnologias do setor naval, aplicando melhores práticas nos projetos;
  • Gerenciar a comunicação com stakeholders internos e externos, incluindo clientes, fornecedores e parceiros internacionais.


Perfil Requerido:

  • Formação Superior completa em Engenharia;
  • Sólida experiência profissional no setor naval;
  • Desejável que este/a profissional possua experiência em projetos internacionais no setor naval;
  • Fortes habilidades de liderança e gestão de equipes;
  • Alta capacidade de resolução de problemas complexos e tomada decisões estratégicas;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e negociação;
  • Necessário possuir inglês fluente.



Sobre a Tenenge :


A Tenenge, marca pertencente a Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção, atua no segmento de Plantas Industriais de forma integrada, reunindo capacidade técnica, gerencial e financeira para executar o ciclo completo de empreendimentos de grande porte em regime de EPC e EPCM, em qualquer parte do mundo.

Com larga experiência no desenvolvimento de projetos de Construção e Montagem, cuja complexidade demanda alta especialização para garantir previsibilidade, eficiência e segurança nos resultado, atua nos seguintes setores:


✔ Petróleo e Gás

✔ Naval

✔ Química e Petroquímica

✔ Termoeletricidade

✔ Bioenergia

✔ Siderurgia & Metalurgia

✔ Papel & Celulose



Sobre a Enseada:


A Enseada é um dos maiores investimentos privados da Bahia nos últimos anos, sendo o veículo que consolidou todo o conhecimento e expertise dos seus acionistas no segmento de construção naval e offshore . Com tecnologia Kawasaki Heavy Industries, a Enseada foi implantada estrategicamente às margens do Rio Paraguaçu, no Estado da Bahia. O estaleiro está localizado em águas abrigadas e com calado profundo, onde não há a incidência de correnteza ou ventos inesperados. Além disso, não há concorrência de atracação com outras indústrias como em outras regiões. Gerando emprego e renda para a região do recôncavo baiano, o local é reconhecido como celeiro de grandes projetos offshore desde a década de 1980.

title: Risk & Audit Expert Talent
description:
Risk & Audit Expert Talent at Randstad Global

Sao Paolo - Brazil, hybrid, fulltime


people at the heart of everything we do

Working at Randstad is unlike working at any organization. Because at Randstad we put people at the heart of everything we do. This goes for our clients, our talent, our employees and society. We combine our passion for people with the power of today’s technologies. This helps us support people and organizations in realizing their true potential. We call this partner for talent..

Learn more about our mission, history and values on our website:


BR&AF

The business risk and audit function (BR&AF) provides assurance and recommendations to the Executive Board and the Audit Committee on Randstad Group’s (risk) management, control and governance practices. Therefore the department facilitates in setting governance standards. It provides advice on internal control improvements, it conducts audits, special investigations and assignments worldwide on request of the Executive Board and Audit Committee. BR&AF’s responsibility includes the quarterly reporting based on: the risk and internal control self assessments, audit results, discussions on internal control weaknesses and analysis of the key risks reported throughout the company's management structure. This also substantiates the Group’s in-control statements.


The global function consists of team members operating through hubs spread over 4 continents. The team is organized in a matrix consisting of control & audit focus teams on business and functional areas (e.g. digital, talent, client, back office & shared service centers and fraud & forensics) and partners that are the linking pin to operating units (business risk & audit partners) with a global view. A support group is set up for professional practice, learning & development, quality improvement & methods, analytics and PMO.


Representatives of the different groups (Focus teams, BR&A Partners and support group) form the BR&AF core management team that reports to the Managing Director BR&AF.


how you will contribute

You are part of the Business Risk & Audit Function (BR&AF) that covers all business operations related to Clients, Talents and our (shared) Back-, Mid- and Front offices, as well as our Accounting & Reporting and other specialist functions like HR.


With your risk & audit experience and expertise you enhance Randstad's in-control situation together with other team members. This by preparing and performing: risk assessments; internal control assessments; audits; and reviews, and compile reports on these activities that make an impact on management.


  • you provide management combined assurance, utilizing insights from enterprise risk management, internal control as well as internal audits that you lead and/or execute. Therewith you create momentum within the company to strengthen the risk-control position for our operational, shared services and accounting processes.
  • you maintain contact with local and international management, global and local process owners and collaborate closely with other involved stakeholders like other impacted functions within the group.
  • you coordinate, execute and report on the outcomes of risk management, internal control and internal audit in close collaboration with other involved and impacted functions within the group, such as: our Client delivery and Talent operations specialists; and HR, Tax, Accounting & Reporting and Planning & Control specialists.
  • you take ownership for the planning, execution and reporting of the risk, internal control and internal audit activities to make impact. You know your impact is there when management follows-up on your reports by implementing operational and control improvements.
  • you are willing to travel. As the standard office locations for the BR&AF team are organized in hubs, like in the country mentioned, travelling is estimated to be about 20% to 30% of the job.


what you will be doing

As an independent and objective risk & audit expert, you are going to:

  • participate and take the lead in risk assessments and audit planning and scoping, including researching relevant business objectives, policies, regulations.
  • prepare and execute audits by evaluating and analyzing the design and operating effectiveness of controls in mitigating identified risks.
  • execute audits and reviews for operational processes and controls, in areas such as: client delivery and Talent intake, as well as shared services operations and specialist functions like HR management, marketing & communication, finance, accounting & reporting, planning & control, non-financial reporting.
  • participate and lead audit interviews, be accountable to prepare audit workpapers and reporting, as well as assist in drafting audit findings and recommendations for management, based on identified control weaknesses or process improvements.
  • support and monitor the follow-up implementation of corrective actions by management.
  • act as a recourse for colleagues with less expertise.


who will you work with

  • Business operations managers both working with our Clients and Talents, as well as shared services center managers and functional specialists in all territories where Randstad is active
  • Business operations and shared services process owners and control owners in all territories where Randstad is active
  • Tax and Legal counterparts (including legal compliance leads) both at corporate level as well as in our operating companies
  • MD BR&AF, other BR&AF leaders, team members and business partners
  • External co-source partners


what you will bring

Your risk & audit skills are well developed, as a critical challenger to process owners and business managers you strike the right tone. You have a keen interest and business acumen for Client delivery and Talent related operational processes as well as shared services organizations, how they serve internal customers and optimize their operations. You have a broad interest in specialist functions that support the overall governance of Randstad's international presence.

As an Internal Audit Expert you:

  • have minimum 8 years of relevant experience
  • have minimum master degree in business or economics and related accreditation (e.g. CPA/CA/CIA/ACCA)
  • have level BEC B1/B2 or higher Business English, preferably combined with proficiency in one of the following languages: Dutch, Spanish, French, Italian and /or German
  • have a strong independent mindset
  • are experienced in international stakeholder management & change
  • are an innovative thinker that challenges the status quo
  • have experience with excel in risk & audit methodologies & tools and internal control theories
  • have an agile and flexible working style and passion for on the job learning & development
  • have a proven track record in control design & implementation, risk based auditing and reporting.
  • are experienced in performing integrated audits working with changing teams
  • are specialized depth and breadth of expertise in business process risk analysis
  • have experience with data driven analysis


your competencies

Within Randstad we defined the following Leadership competencies:

  • delighting people: connect people (client, talent, employee, society), building strong client relationships and delivering client-centric solutions.
  • performing today: resourcefulness securing and developing resources effectively and efficiently.
  • leading change: manages ambiguity operating effectively, even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.
  • securing the future: drives vision and purpose painting a compelling picture of the vision and strategy that motivates others into action.
  • creating clarity - showing line of sight: making sense of complex, high quantity and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems and provides direction, is delegating and removing obstacles to get work done
  • courage to challenge: shows courage and confidence to speak up skillfully, challenging others even when they are confronted with resistance or unfamiliar circumstances
  • collaborates, reaches out, you excel in organizational sensitivity: maneuvering comfortably through complex policy, process and people-related organizational dynamics recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization


what’s in it for you

We put people at the heart of everything we do. Our employment conditions reflect this and are in accordance with the applicable (local) Randstad employment policies and related personnel guide.

We want our teams and talent to reflect the rich diversity of the societies we serve. We thrive for an environment of belonging, safety and confidence. So everyone can bring their whole selves to work and flourish. Learn more about equity, diversity, inclusion and belonging at randstad here .


If you recognize yourself in the profile above, we invite you to apply for this role. For more information you can reach out to our recruitment business partner:


The recruitment procedure consists of a screening and at least two interviews. Later in the process, an (online) assessment and a job offer conversation take place.

To apply, please submit your resume (CV) and a cover letter.

title: Project Engineer
description:
Project Engineer – Substations & High Voltage


(ENGLISH SPEAKERS)


Location: The Netherlands (on-site), 1-2 - year contract with potential of permanent employment, NOT project/freelance


Are you passionate about large-scale infrastructure and high-voltage energy systems? Join a forward-thinking engineering team dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions in substations (up to 500kV) and energy transmission projects across global markets.


We're looking for an experienced Project Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of substation and high-voltage projects. You’ll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, contribute to energy transition solutions, and bring excellence to our electromechanical and protection systems.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Develop basic and executive electromechanical designs for high-voltage substations (69kV to 500kV)
  • Prepare and analyze layout drawings, grounding mesh, cable routing, and auxiliary systems (AC/DC)
  • Design single-line, three-line, and interconnection diagrams
  • Ensure compliance with international standards (IEC, ANSI, IEEE, ABNT)
  • Perform technical documentation review and approval (FATs, BOMs, technical specs)
  • Interface with clients, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams
  • Contribute to engineering reports including ROI, CAPEX, and technical feasibility


What We’re Looking For:


  • Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in high-voltage substation design (preferred: 230kV to 500kV)
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD (See Electrical, Eplan P8 or similar is a plus)
  • Familiarity with SCADA, protection and control systems
  • Solid knowledge of substation equipment: CTs, PTs, surge arresters, circuit breakers, transformers, disconnectors
  • Experience with software like CYMCAP, DiaLUX, PVsyst (nice to have)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments
  • English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus


Bonus:

  • Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems)
  • Exposure to EPC projects and multidisciplinary coordination
  • Understanding of ESG practices in engineering


Why Join Us:

  • Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems
  • Get involved in international projects with real impact
  • Grow within a dynamic and mission-driven company
  • Remote flexibility and a collaborative, innovation-driven culture



Who is Xelvin?


Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. We hire Artisans, National Degree, Bachelor, Masters and PHD candidates with a background in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Automotive and Physics. Our focus is within the High-Tech and Manufacturing industry in Eindhoven region.


Xelvin is specialized in International Recruitment, within Europe and beyond. In the past years we have helped over a thousand candidates from more than 50 different nationalities with finding their perfect job here in the Netherlands and are striving to help so many more!


As Xelvin we hire candidates for a specific position for a set amount of time, after which a permanent contract with our client is granted and the candidates automatically transfers.


What do we offer?


Contract wise:


· 1-2 year contract of 40 hours per week (with potential of long-term employment).

· 25 paid holidays a year (+ potential ADV days)

· Public holidays, with a maximum of 7 per year, which are paid by Xelvin.

· Holiday allowance of 8.33% (instead of 8,0%) over your total gross annual income. Paid each year in May.

· Overtime and shift allowance will be paid by Xelvin accordingly.

· Travel allowance of €0,23 per km, for the use of travelling to work and back home.

· Competitive salary (based on level of education and experience)



Onboarding & benefits:


· Your 1st house in the Netherlands will be supported by Xelvin, with the help of our Housing Consultant (we help you find accommodation). In case of having to pay the 1st months rent or potential deposit, Xelvin is willing to pay it for you upfront, after which we’ll set up a loan agreement, for you to pay us back in terms.


· A relocation assistance allowance of €1000 - €3000,00 NET will be paid to you, to assist with the cost of relocating to the Netherlands.


· You (and your family/partner) will be picked up at the airport or train station by your consultant/ recruiter after your arrival and will be taken to your new house.


· Onboarding: we’ll advise you on how to set up a Dutch bank account, apply for health insurance, getting a Dutch BSN number, writing in with a dentist and general practitioner and other useful or necessary cases to arrange.


· New Hire Dinner organized for all newly recruited engineers to make them aware of our Dutch tax system and explaining the Dutch payslip.


· A few social gatherings with all Xelvin employees and recruited engineers;


o New Years drink at the local PSV stadium, where you’ll get a tour of the building and beverages and bites are served.


o Summer BBQ at the Evoluon, where you can grow your social circle and dance to some nice music while enjoying the food.

Conhecimentos: Habilidade em negociação, atendimento ao cliente, e conhecimento do mercado de móveis estofados de luxo. Conhecimento sobre o universo de arquitetura e design de interiores é um diferencial.

Experiência intermediária em AutoCAD e Projact – Será Testado ;

Experiência intermediária em Excel e Pacote Office – Será Testado ;

  • Capacidade de aplicar e fiscalizar as normas de higiene e segurança alimentar.
  • De Resultado:Foco em metas e resultados de vendas do setor.

  • Considerando a necessidade de liderança, foco em resultados e atenção aos processos, o perfil DISC para um Encarregado de Açougue de sucesso no Mais Prático tende a apresentar uma combinação de:
  • Dominância (D): Para liderar a equipe com firmeza e direcionamento, buscando resultados.
  • Influência (I): Para motivar a equipe, comunicar-se eficazmente com clientes e criar um ambiente positivo.

Responsibilities:

Requirements:


1. Education: Bachelor's degree or above in international trade, logistics management, e-commerce, or related fields.


2. Experience:

◦ At least 3 years of experience in cross-border e-commerce and customs management.

◦ Experience operating e-commerce platforms in Brazil preferred.


3. Skills:

◦ Familiar with and proficient in customs processes between Brazil and China, and platform operation standards.

◦ Excellent communication and negotiation skills, capable of negotiating in various complex situations.

◦ Strong analytical skills for problem location and project management; ability to proactively optimize and implement solutions.

◦ Proficient in using relevant customs management software and e-commerce platform tools.


4. Language:

◦ Strong sense of responsibility and attention to business details.

◦ Adapt to rapidly changing international e-commerce environment and actively promote ongoing business development.

◦ Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em comércio eletrônico transfronteiriço e gestão aduaneira.

◦ Experiência operando plataformas de comércio eletrônico no Brasil preferida.


3. Habilidades:

◦ Familiaridade e proficiência nos processos aduaneiros entre Brasil e China, e normas de operação de plataforma.

◦ Fortes habilidades analíticas para localização de problemas e gerenciamento de projetos; capacidade de otimizar e implementar soluções proativamente.

◦ Fluente em português, com excelentes habilidades de escrita e fala.

◦ Fluente em inglês; habilidades em mandarim são preferidas.


5. Outros Requisitos:

◦ Forte senso de responsabilidade e atenção aos detalhes do negócio.

◦ Adaptar-se a um ambiente de comércio eletrônico internacional em rápida mudança e promover ativamente o desenvolvimento contínuo dos negócios.

title: Procurement Specialist
description:
The Procurement Manager will be responsible for managing the procurement process for requests, ensuring that the end user has the necessary resources to execute projects effectively. This role will involve collaborating with various stakeholders, negotiating with suppliers, and maintaining compliance with organizational procurement policies.


Key Responsibilities:

Develop and implement procurement strategies that align with the company's objectives. Manage end-to-end procurement processes, including sourcing, negotiation, and contract management. Identify and evaluate potential suppliers, negotiate contracts, and ensure adherence to terms and conditions.

Conduct regular performance reviews with suppliers to ensure optimal service delivery. Monitor market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities for cost savings and process improvements. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand procurement needs and ensure the timely delivery of goods and services.

Ensure compliance with procurement policies, procedures, and regulations. Maintain accurate records of purchases, pricing, and other essential data.

Prepare and present reports on procurement activities, cost savings, and supplier performance to senior management.


Requirements：

Bachelor's degree or above, preferably in International Trade, Logistics Management, Supply Chain Management, or related fields.

At least 6 years of experience in procurement, previous experience with comparable logistic projects in the KSA or Middle East region is required.

Familiar with procurement processes and relevant laws and regulations, with strong contract negotiation and supplier management skills.

In-depth knowledge of international logistic best practices and supply chain management.

Para o match perfeito acontecer precisa de PESSOAS, com as mais diversas experiências e pontos de vista, para que possamos continuar evoluindo enquanto empresa.

Por isso, aqui na SulAmérica, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas de todas as raças/etnias, orientações sexuais, identidades de gênero, gerações, com ou sem deficiência, para todas as nossas vagas. Afinal, as nossas diferenças é o que nos complementam!

#LGBTI+ #PessoasNegras #PcD #50+ #Gerações #PessoasComDeficiência


Como será o seu dia a dia na área de Serviços Médicos:

A área é responsável pela análise detalhada de internações (eletivas e de urgência), procedimentos, materiais e medicamentos. Ela serve como ponto de contato entre clientes, ouvidoria, prestadores e beneficiários.

Seu trabalho é guiado por diretrizes internas, normas da ANS e tendências de mercado, sempre com sólido conhecimento técnico.

É essencial que a área execute as ações de forma eficiente, buscando melhorias e otimizações. O acompanhamento de indicadores de desempenho é crucial para guiar as atividades.

A área também propõe mudanças, analisa o perfil das solicitações e concilia a gestão de sinistros com a experiência do cliente.


Principais responsabilidades:

Realizar apoio técnico, estimular o conhecimento e instaurar o inconformismo;

Desenvolver análise de Dados e Indicadores: Avaliar dados de sinistros, feedback de clientes e outros indicadores relevantes para identificar gargalos, pontos de fricção e áreas com potencial de melhoria;

Proposição de Melhorias Processuais com base na análise, propor e desenvolver novas abordagens, fluxos de trabalho e políticas que otimizem a gestão de sinistros, reduzam custos e agilizem o atendimento;

Focando na experiência do cliente: Garantir que as mudanças propostas considerem o impacto na jornada do cliente, buscando soluções que tornem o processo de sinistro mais transparente, ágil e menos burocrático;

Conquistando equilíbrio entre custo e qualidade: Buscar um equilíbrio entre a eficiência na gestão de custos de sinistros e a qualidade do serviço prestado ao cliente, evitando que medidas de redução de custos comprometam a experiência do cliente;

Colaboração Interdepartamental: Trabalhar em conjunto com outras áreas da empresa, como atendimento ao cliente, área técnica de sinistros, TI , compliance, prestadores, central de atendimento, concierge, entre outras, para garantir a implementação eficaz das mudanças propostas;

Acompanhar os resultados das mudanças implementadas, avaliando seu impacto nos indicadores de sinistro e na satisfação do cliente, e realizar ajustes conforme necessário;

Implementar novas tecnologias: Avaliar e propor a adoção de novas tecnologias e ferramentas que possam otimizar a gestão de sinistros e melhorar a experiência do cliente;

Treinamento e Comunicação: Garantir que as equipes envolvidas sejam devidamente treinadas sobre as novas políticas e processos, e comunicar de forma clara e eficaz as mudanças aos clientes, quando necessário;

Garantir um ambiente confiável;

Estabelecer Metas claras e acompanhar.


O que esperamos de conhecimentos para essa vaga:

Formação Superior Completa em Medicina e especialização (preferencia por áreas cirúrgicas)

Experiência prévia na liderança de equipes;

Entendimento das normas, regulamentações e processos do setor de saúde suplementar;

Habilidade e conhecimento de Office;

description:
Cidade: Curitiba

A Salvy é uma operadora de telefonia móvel que está crescendo muito rápido, nós fornecemos linhas telefônicas e uma plataforma que revoluciona a forma como empresas consomem telecom e TI. Participamos recentemente do programa de aceleração mais importante do mundo, a Y Combinator, e com a ajuda deles estamos iniciando uma nova fase na Salvy.


Saiba mais sobre a nossa cultura aqui: 


Espere trabalhar com um time pequeno de tamanho mas grande em competência. Somos todos generalistas, sempre buscando desenvolver o nosso melhor trabalho. Estamos buscando uma pessoa engenheira, com alta capacidade de execução que gosta de construir coisas do zero utilizando Typescript, NodeJS e React. Se você é esta pessoa, entre em contato com a gente.


Na Salvy, temos a visão de construir uma plataforma de produtos integrados, que facilitam a vida dos gestores de TI de médias e grandes empresas. Para suportar essa visão precisamos de uma pessoa engenheira capaz de adotar um produto da plataforma como seu, sendo responsável por participar ativamente desde da definição de roadmap até a implementação e monitoramento do produto.


O que você fará?

  • Construir um produto, voltado ao usuário. Você será fundamental em todas as etapas de construção, trabalhando próximo de outros engenheiros e designers, desde a construção do roadmap, modelagem dos dados, interface e serviços envolvidos.
  • Código de qualidade. Nós acreditamos que todos os engenheiros são responsáveis por garantir a qualidade dos produtos e por isso prezamos muito por escrever códigos testáveis e escaláveis.
  • Implementar análises, monitoramento e alertas em nosso serviço para que possamos melhor responder a incidentes operacionais.
  • Escrever e revisar ADRs para promover a discussão e o compartilhamento de conhecimento entre os membros do time.
  • Influenciar na stack e tecnologias utilizadas. Nós usamos NextJS no Frontend e NodeJS no backend, e a medida que crescermos você fará parte das escolhas mais críticas das nossa infraestrutura.
  • Atendimento de demandas dos clientes. Nós temos uma agenda de rotatividade em que uma pessoa engenheira é responsável por atender às demandas vindas por meio do canal de atendimento aos clientes. Não se preocupe, não trabalhamos em escala de plantão e esperamos que trabalhe apenas durante seu horário normal de trabalho.


O que estamos procurando?

  • Demonstração de capacidade de executar: Você prosperou em ambientes complexos e de crescimento rápido.
  • Resolução de problemas: Para você, resolver problemas começa com um entendimento claro e preciso do contexto. Você consegue decompor problemas complicados e trabalhar em direção a uma solução clara, sozinho ou com colegas de equipe. Você se sente confortável pedindo ajuda quando necessário.
  • Curiosidade e aprendizado rápido: Não esperamos que você tenha experiência em todas as tecnologias que utilizamos, mas que aprenda e se torne produtivo rapidamente.
  • Sensibilidade para design: Embora você co-crie a interface com designers e engenheiros incríveis, esperamos que você tenha um olhar crítico para UX, de modo que você sinta quando algo está fora do lugar e possa apontar ou, melhor ainda, aprimorar.
  • Orientação à impacto: Você se preocupa com o impacto nos negócios e prioriza suas tarefas de acordo. Você não persegue apenas o que é legal — você entende o equilíbrio entre habilidade, velocidade e resultado final.
  • Colocar pessoas em primeiro lugar: Você pensa criticamente sobre as implicações do que está construindo e como isso afeta a vida das pessoas.
  • Colaboração: Para você, o trabalho não é um esforço solo. Você gosta de colaborar com funções diversas para alcançar objetivos compartilhados, e se importa com aprender, crescer e ajudar os outros a fazer o mesmo.


Tecnologias usadas

Bonus:

  • tRPC e Tailwind para nossa plataforma web

description:
SDR (Sales Development Representative)


Local: VR Advogados | (Presencial - Vitória/ES)

Setor: Comercial | Prospecção

Sobre a oportunidade

Na VR Advogados, acreditamos que crescimento previsível começa com prospecção estruturada e inteligente . Por isso, buscamos SDRs com espírito empreendedor, que saibam conversar sobre negócios e queiram fazer parte da construção de um processo comercial escalável, orientado por dados e focado em resultados reais.

Não buscamos apenas mais um vendedor. Buscamos alguém que tenha visão estratégica, goste de resolver problemas e seja apaixonado por gerar oportunidades que impactam empresas de verdade.

O que você vai fazer
  • Prospectar leads outbound com base em listas qualificadas e ICPs bem definidos;
  • Enviar e-mails estratégicos com abordagem Cold Calling 2.0 para gerar interesse e abrir conversas de negócio;
  • Conduzir conversas de alto nível com sócios, diretores e empresários, entendendo suas dores reais;
  • Qualificar oportunidades com inteligência, mapeando fit e urgência;
  • Passar o bastão para o executivo de vendas no momento certo, garantindo transições fluidas e com contexto;
  • Trabalhar com dados, processos e tecnologia (CRM, e-mail outbound, cadências, dashboards etc.);
  • Ajudar a refinar o processo de prospecção com aprendizados contínuos.
Perfil ideal
  • Empreendedor(a) : você encara problemas com atitude de dono e curiosidade por soluções;
  • Organizado(a) e com mentalidade de processo : sabe que sem rotina, não há escala;
  • Aprende rápido e se comunica com clareza, especialmente em temas de negócio;
  • Ganha confiança com facilidade : sabe conversar com decisores sem parecer um vendedor “empurrador”;
  • Íntegro(a), confiável e disciplinado(a) : não promete o que não pode cumprir;
  • Ama ouvir mais do que falar , e transformar dores em soluções comerciais;
  • Preferencialmente já atuou com B2B, vendas consultivas ou tem familiaridade com negócios ;
  • Gosta de trabalhar em dupla ou time , com sinergia e foco em alavancagem.
Métricas que importam para nós
  • Leads qualificados gerados por mês
  • Conversas relevantes com tomadores de decisão
  • Pipeline real gerado para o time de vendas
  • Eficiência em cadências e processos
  • Domínio das etapas do funil outbound
O que oferecemos
  • Treinamento intensivo com base em Receita Previsível e melhores práticas de mercado;
  • Ferramentas modernas de vendas (CRM, automações, templates);
  • Ambiente de crescimento acelerado com mentoria constante;
  • Participação em decisões estratégicas sobre o processo comercial;
  • Remuneração fixa acima do mercado + variável agressiva;
  • Reconhecimento e possibilidade de escalar para Closer, Líder de SDR ou Revenue Ops.
O que NÃO buscamos
  • Vendedores que querem “fechar na marra”;
  • Pessoas desorganizadas ou sem vontade de seguir processos;
  • Profissionais que esperam ser empurrados a cada passo.
Resumo

Esta vaga é para quem quer construir algo grande, com método, disciplina e visão de longo prazo . Se você quer ser um dos pilares de crescimento de uma empresa que está mudando a forma como os empresários brasileiros lidam com dívidas bancárias, vem com a gente .


Candidate-se agora pelo LinkedIn.

title: Gerente de loja de varejo
description:
Descrição da vaga

Se você é uma pessoa determinada, comprometida e com experiência na área de varejo, esta vaga de Gerente de Supermercado pode ser a oportunidade perfeita para alavancar sua carreira. Estamos em busca de um profissional qualificado que possa liderar nossa equipe e impulsionar o sucesso do nosso supermercado.

Responsabilidades


Como gerente de supermercado, você será responsável por liderar a equipe e garantir que todas as operações diárias sejam realizadas de forma eficiente e eficaz. Isso significa que você terá que supervisionar o trabalho dos funcionários, delegar tarefas e garantir que todos estejam desempenhando suas funções corretamente.


Além disso, será sua responsabilidade garantir que o estoque esteja sempre abastecido e organizado, controlando inventários e realizando pedidos quando necessário. Você deve se certificar de que os produtos estejam em boas condições e dentro da validade, para garantir a satisfação dos clientes.


Como gerente, você também deverá lidar com situações delicadas, como reclamações de clientes insatisfeitos ou conflitos entre membros da equipe. É fundamental ter habilidades de comunicação eficazes e saber resolver problemas de forma rápida e justa.


Por fim, como gerente de supermercado, você será o representante da empresa perante a comunidade. Isso significa que você deve estar preparado para interagir com clientes, fornecedores e outros parceiros comerciais de forma profissional e cortês.


Qualificações


1. Experiência no ramo varejista no mínimo 3 anos : Para se destacar como gerente de supermercado, é fundamental ter experiência prévia no setor varejista. Isso inclui a compreensão das operações do supermercado, como o controle de estoque, gestão de compras e logística.


2. Habilidade em liderança: Ser um bom líder é crucial para o cargo de gerente. Você deve ser capaz de motivar e inspirar sua equipe a alcançar metas e garantir a satisfação dos clientes. Isso requer habilidades em comunicação eficaz, resolução de problemas e tomada de decisões assertivas.


3. Conhecimento em gestão financeira: Como gerente, você será responsável pelo orçamento do supermercado e pelo controle das finanças. Ter conhecimentos sólidos em gestão financeira ajudará a tomar decisões estratégicas para otimizar os lucros e reduzir custos desnecessários.


4. Capacidade organizacional: A gestão eficiente do tempo e a capacidade de organizar tarefas são fundamentais para o sucesso como gerente de supermercado. Você precisa ser capaz de desenvolver cronogramas eficientes, delegar responsabilidades adequadamente e manter uma operação suave e eficiente.


5. Habilidades em atendimento ao cliente: Ser capaz de lidar com os clientes de forma amigável e cortês é essencial para garantir a satisfação do cliente. Como gerente de supermercado, você deve ter habilidades em atendimento ao cliente para resolver problemas e lidar com situações delicadas.


6. Conhecimento sobre regulamentações sanitárias: Supermercados precisam cumprir uma série de regulamentações sanitárias para assegurar a qualidade e segurança dos produtos comercializados. Ter conhecimento sobre essas regulamentações é importante para garantir que o supermercado esteja em conformidade com todas as normas.


  • 7. Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade: O setor varejista está em constante mudança, exigindo que os gerentes sejam flexíveis e capazes de se adaptar rapidamente às novas tendências e demandas do mercado. A capacidade de se ajustar a diferentes situações é uma característica importante para um gerente de supermercado bem-sucedido.

title: Murex ERM
description:
Project Description

DXC Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade, and migration. We provide end-to-end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury, and insurance.


Whether you possess a background in finance, technology, or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.


Responsibilities

- Part of an embedment team, candidates will be part of Murex application support / build team performing the following responsibilities:

- Resolve daily Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) issues on both functional, valuation, and pricing

- Liaise with the technical team(s) -- when needed -- to resolve ERM related issues and necessary enhancements

- Develop ERM Business requirements per given stream and according to Project needs as they come along

- Products (IRD, CRD, EQD, FXD) management and validation

- Manage day-to-day assigned project tasks to complete various ERM deliverables

- Contribute and assist existing support group(s) in resolving requests or issues with ERM, VaR, P&L, Market Data, and booking issues

- Analyze, formulate, propose, develop and/or contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables

- Continuous follow-up of new Market regulations/practices globally

- Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)

- Ability to utilize specialized knowledge on financial derivatives and Murex software to participate in implementation and upgrade projects throughout scoping, design, build and validation phases.

- Provide high-quality support in using the Murex platform for pricing and structuring of complex financial products within trading domain (e.g. FX derivatives, interest rates derivatives, Fixed Income etc.).

- Develop test cases to troubleshoot the system, document defective use cases for fixes by developers.


Skills Description

- Strong analytical, pricing, and ERM skills

- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail

- Strong presentation skills

- Strong relationship building skills both internally and externally

- Strong experience in supporting FO users and resolving their daily issues


Must:

- 2+ years experience on Murex with ERM, VaR, and Risk functionalities/module

- 1+ years of experience in financial markets/IT business analysis

- Must have a strong personality, logical and analytical skills

- Be detailed-oriented, a quick learner, and a self-starter

- Possess good verbal and written communication skills

- Must have strong organization skills

title: Risk Control Strategy - Brazil
description:
Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Join us to collaborate with a world-class team, driving innovation and growth for our food delivery platform in global markets, while enjoying extensive career development opportunities and working alongside global tech talents.


Job Responsibilities:

  1. Responsible for risk control strategy development at Keeta, including but not limited to risk feature mining, strategy development and maintenance, and customer complaint data analysis.
  2. Collaborate with business teams to provide risk assessment solutions, monitor real-time risk trends, and drive joint efforts with business units to enhance anti-risk capabilities.
  3. Respond promptly to sudden online risks, identify root causes, and coordinate internal resources to minimize losses.
  4. Strengthen risk control infrastructure by working with product, R&D, and algorithm teams to optimize systems and models, ensuring continuous improvement in the robustness of the risk control framework.

Requirements:

  1. Bachelor’s degree or above, with strong logical thinking, proficiency in SQL and data analysis. Experience in risk control is a plus.
  2. Proficient in English for workplace communication; open to long-term business travel.
  3. Strong collaboration skills to work closely with business, product, and R&D teams to achieve risk control objectives.
  4. Business-oriented mindset: Proactively understand business workflows and goals, and adapt risk control measures flexibly to align with business changes.
  5. Strong risk awareness with expertise in risk identification, analysis, and mitigation, coupled with rapid learning capabilities.

Job Highlights:

  • Entrepreneurial environment with international exposure. Tackle challenges from complex environments, languages, cultures, and habits. Your strategic solutions will drive holistic professional growth.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in overseas risk control
  • Proficiency in English or Portuguese
  • Willingness to accept long-term business travel to Brazil or be based in Brazil


岗位职责:

1. 负责Keeta风控策略工作，包括但不限于风险特征挖掘、策略生产与维护、客诉数据分析。

2. 与业务团队协同，提供方案风险评估、监控线上风险变化并推动业务共同完善对抗能力落地。

3. 对于线上突发风险进行应急响应，第一时间定位问题并协调团队内部资源进行快速止损。

4. 沉淀风控基建能力，推动产研、算法共同优化系统、模型能力，持续完善风控体系的健壮程度。


岗位要求:

1. 本科及以上学历，思维逻辑好，有一定sql和数据分析能力，有风控经验加分。

2. 能够熟练使用英语进行工作交流，可接受长期差旅。

3. 较强的协作能力，能够与业务团队、产研团队保持紧密协同，达成风控目标。

4. 具备业务思维，能够主动了解业务流程与业务目标，并能够根据业务变化灵活调整风控尺度。

5. 风险意识强，掌握风险研判、分析、管控相关的技能，并具备较强的学习能力。


岗位亮点:

创业型业务，国际化视野，面向更复杂的环境、语言、文化、习惯等挑战，你的策略方案，可以从全局得到锻炼与成长。

境外风控经验--英语或葡萄牙语--可接受长期出差巴西 或 base 巴西

title: Growth Partnership Executive (SaaS | Contractor)
description:
About SleekFlow

Join SleekFlow, a thriving SaaS startup that is experiencing rapid growth thanks to the support of renowned investors which include Atinum Investment, Tiger Global, Transcend Capital and Gobi Partners. Our mission is to shape the future of communication by empowering companies to center all their workflows around meaningful conversations. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to thrive alongside the company through equity options. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and assume a larger role, we look forward to meeting you!


At SleekFlow, we have developed an Omnichannel Conversational AI Suite that drives conversions through conversations. Our platform seamlessly integrates with popular channels such as WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, WeChat, and more, providing comprehensive communication solutions. With our customer engagement platform, both small merchants and large enterprises can automate growth by enhancing productivity across their sales, marketing, and support teams.


As we expand into emerging markets, we seek adventurous, diverse, and passionate individuals to join us on this exciting journey. Join our team and grow your career with SleekFlow!


Junior to Associate Level

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Prior Experience in Saas/ Software Industry is preferred

Language: Fluent in English & Portuguese; Professional proficiency in Spanish


Role

We are looking for an ambitious Growth Partnership Executive to join our dynamic sales team. In this role, you will build and manage prospect relationships to drive revenue for SleekFlow. A vital part of this opportunity is partnering with the Customer Success and Product team to ensure the quality and quantity of sales pipeline.


Responsibilities

  • Handle our sales conversion process for Small & Medium Businesses
  • Developing and managing relationships within our Commercial segment with customers in the LATAM region.
  • Forecast sales activity and revenue achievement while creating satisfied and reference-able customers
  • Research and build >40 "cold accounts" (i.e.: adding contacts, sending emails, cold calling) everyday
  • Support our inbound and outbound sales teams in closing enterprise clients
  • Qualify leads and nurture them through the initial stages of the buyer journeys
  • Handle inbound tickets
  • Document all interactions and findings with leads in our CRM, and create a seamless handoff process to Account Executives
  • Involve in our International Market Expansion
  • Work with our sales teams, customer support, partnership and training team in Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, UAE and oversee the market launch project
  • Ability to stay up to date in the SaaS landscape and demonstrate our platform value


Requirements

  • Minimum 1 years of outbound sales or sales development experience (selling over the phone, cold calling), preferably B2B at a software company
  • Profound academic background from top-notch universities
  • Extensive experience selling to customers in the LATAM region
  • Consistently over-achieved quota (top 5-10% of the company) in past positions
  • Fluency in English is a MUST
  • Previous Experience in a startup is preferred


Desired Skills

  • Strong and demonstrated written and verbal communication skills.
  • Previous Sales Methodology training preferred.
  • CRM (e.g. Hubspot) & marketing experience preferred
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, team environment.
  • Strong customer references
  • Strong computer skills, including CRM, Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel.



Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate.


SleekFlow is a place where everyone can grow. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

description:

Coordinate pricing strategies with HQ sales assistant team and assist with technical questions always contribute marketing intelligence to keep Neway ‘s biding offer in competitive stage and win the official order, so that to comply with the annual sale and order booking target.

title: Sales Training Facilitator (Brazilian Portuguese Speaker)
description:
RAIN Group, an award-winning global provider of innovative sales training and performance improvement services, is seeking contract sales training facilitators to add to our expanding team


This is a part-time, contract role.


Are you an independent sales training facilitator who is fluent in Brazilian Portuguese and English and is looking to align with a proven, time-tested sales methodology infused across a wide and deep portfolio of training offerings?


We are seeking dynamic individuals who are experts in training facilitation and who have experience delivering engaging learning in any of the following industries: technology, manufacturing, financial services, healthcare, or professional services.


Do you relish the opportunity to work with salespeople, sales managers and sales leaders to help them unleash their own sales potential and that of their organizations?


Do you thrive on delivering high-energy, high-impact, active learning experiences that make the participants the stars of the show?


This role is primarily responsible for crafting, delivering, and enabling our solutions in Brazil, with potential to work on select engagements in global settings. Your main focus will be to drive transformation and achieve results for learners and clients by delivering tailored content and RAIN Group IP through training, coaching, and reinforcement, utilizing a variety of delivery mediums.


Role Highlights:

You'll work within our client and product teams and be responsible for partnering directly with clients to execute the delivery of our programs so they achieve mutually agreed client results. This includes the tailoring of content, and the delivery and facilitation of sessions, coaching, and reinforcement.


You'll be expected to

· Drive client transformation and results by delivering world-class programming

· Project manage client engagements to ensure seamless execution, custom design, and details managed/produced on time and on budget

· Master IP knowledge, and be a source for others as an IP expert

· Meet expected KPI for client feedback on programming and facilitation

· Collaborate with internal teams on behalf of the client, accessing project management, development, content, technology to enable successful deliveries

· Maintain professional client and internal communication at the highest level

· Support sales or large-scale projects as needed

· Provide feedback to sales, product, marketing, and client results teams as needed


Desired Skills, Attributes, and Competencies:

Successful candidates are innately curious and creative thinkers with motivational energy who are comfortable working as part of a team. Training facilitators must have a sound understanding of adult learning theory and the use of experiential learning techniques.


Additional requirements include:

· Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese

· Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree

· Training facilitation experience and stellar references

· Demonstrated experience selling and/or leading sales teams

· Outstanding group facilitation and presentation skills

· Working knowledge of MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and modern collaboration software

· Exceptional oral and written communication skills

· Knowledge of the instructional design process

· Ability to adapt and relate to all levels of leadership, management, and employees with ease and enthusiasm

· Ability to ramp up quickly on specific verticals and organizations

· Open to coaching and feedback

· Willingness to travel extensively domestically and open to international travel

· Reasonably convenient access to a major airport hub

· Availability and interest in training in the range of 2-10 days per month (exclusive of travel) depending upon demand


About Us

RAIN Group is a global sales training and consulting company that helps leading organizations improve sales results. Founded in 2002, we are experiencing significant growth and have established a reputation as a world-leader in sales training and consulting.


We take our company values seriously: Client Results, Excellence @ Speed, Openness, and Commitment to the Success of Others.

title: Analista de Implantação de ERP - Módulos Financeiro, Supply Chain, WMS e/ou Fiscal/Contábil
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.

Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade : Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Entusiasmo: Acreditamos que o entusiasmo e a positividade são essenciais para o sucesso. Quem ama o que faz trabalha com alegria e aproveita a jornada.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Estamos procurando profissionais dinâmicos e proativos, com uma atitude positiva e habilidades em negócios e sistemas para trabalho em equipe. Valorizamos paciência, comprometimento e a capacidade de lidar bem com usuários e clientes.

Se você já tem experiência em implantação de sistemas, excelente! Caso contrário, oferecemos um ambiente onde você pode aprender constantemente. Fazer parte da nossa equipe exige dedicação e disposição para adquirir um profundo conhecimento sobre nosso sistema.

Esta oportunidade inclui viagens para várias localidades do Brasil.


Responsabilidades:


  • Executar a implantação de sistemas, estando alocado ou não no cliente, ministrando treinamentos para gestores e colaboradores do cliente;
  • Ministrar treinamentos acerca das parametrizações e demais funcionalidades garantindo pleno conhecimento e satisfação do cliente;
  • Preparar documentação dos módulos correspondentes;
  • Realizar testes das funcionalidades considerando as regras de negócios do ERP;
  • Participar de reuniões, inclusive com o cliente, parceiros da Bluesoft e a equipe da Bluesoft;
  • Documentar os treinamentos e enviar relatório de atendimento que demonstre a evolução dos treinamentos ministrados e enviar às partes interessadas.


Requisitos:


  • Residir na Grande São Paulo;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;


Importante: Na Bluesoft, cada consultor atua no módulo em que possui mais experiência e familiaridade. Ou seja, você não precisará dominar todos os módulos — vamos direcionar sua atuação com base no seu principal conhecimento. Abaixo, detalhamos o que esperamos de conhecimento e experiência em cada módulo:


  • Conhecimento Financeiro: Experiência em rotinas financeiras, incluindo Contas a Pagar, Receber, Tesouraria, Conciliação de cartões e bancária, Fluxo de Caixa, Controle Orçamentário e troca de arquivos bancários via EDI.


  • Conhecimento Supply Chain: Rotina de Compras, Pricing (Precificação de Produtos e Margem Líquida), Recebimento de Mercadorias, Conhecimento Básico da Tributação (NCM, IPI, ICMS, PIS), Processos no Varejo.


  • Conhecimento WMS: Experiência na rotina de Centros de Distribuição: recebimento de mercadorias, armazenamento e endereçamento de produtos, gestão de estoque, separação e expedição de pedidos, devolução de mercadorias, inventário e controle de inventário, integração com sistemas de transporte e logística.


  • Conhecimento Contábil: Plano de Contas, Lançamentos Contábeis, Conciliações Contábeis, Conhecimento de obrigações Acessórias (ECD e ECF), Ativo Imobilizado, Depreciação e Amortização, CIAP, Contabilização de Folha de Pagamento, Apuração de IRPJ e CSLL, etc.


  • Conhecimento Fiscal: ICMS, ICMS ST, PIS, COFINS, DIFAL, FCP, IPI, FUNRURAL, Sped Fiscal, Sped Contribuições, EFD REINF, NCM, CEST, CST, CFOP, retenções na fonte sobre serviços tomados/prestados (IRRF, CSRF, ISS, INSS);



Requisitos Desejáveis:


  • Familiaridade com análise de atualizações na legislação societária e normas contábeis;
  • Conhecimento ou vivência no Comercial de redes varejistas, como comprador ou assistente de compras;
  • Experiência com Implantação de Sistemas/Consultor de ERP ou como Key User (usuário chave) de ERP;
  • Ensino Superior em Administração, Finanças, Ciências Contábeis ou cursos relacionados à Gestão e Negócios;
  • Experiência com Varejo;
  • Familiaridade com PDVs e arquivos de cupons fiscais;
  • Experiência no Comercial de redes varejistas, como comprador ou assistente de compras;
  • Visão analítica para apresentação de relatórios de BI com o objetivo de atender às necessidades do cliente;
  • Resiliência e capacidade de autoaprendizagem.

title: IT Helpdesk Engineer, Corporate IT
description:
Corporate IT is the backbone of our business. Our team helps the company to develop a competitive advantage through defining our technology objectives, assessing solution options, and devising technical solutions that help us achieve both strategic goals and meet operational requirements. As a part of our team, you’ll help deliver seamless IT experiences and support to our internal employees by providing responsive helpdesk service, stable networks and reliable IT systems.


As a Helpdesk Engineer, you will be responsible for implementing IT operations according to policy, interpret IT related issues on both System and User side to meet corporate requirements, and provide technical support in a fast-paced and demanding environment.


Job Description:

  • Provide day-to-day technical support to end users and ensure the smooth running of computers, network devices and printers
  • Troubleshoot and resolve end user application issues, maintain and update technical support documentation
  • Handle asset management, maintain inventory and liaise with vendors
  • Maintain and monitor office network infrastructure, IT security and antivirus tools
  • Other duties include performing first level troubleshooting and support for scheduled server backups, system monitoring and reports


Job Requirements:

  • Diploma or degree in Computer Sciences, Information Technology or a related field preferred
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant experience operating in a similar role
  • In-depth knowledge of computer hardware, software, and OS (Windows and macOS)
  • Understanding of TCP/IP, IP addressing and LAN technology including switching and routing fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience in Windows server administration and basic knowledge in Linux server administration is a plus
  • Professional Qualification - Microsoft Certified/CCNA is a plus
  • Knowledge of basic setup and configuration of Cisco devices such as firewall, switch, IP phones, wireless controller and access points is a plus
  • Competent at documenting standard operating procedures and knowledge articles
  • Ability to cover after-office hours and weekend support if there are any infrastructure issues or activities
  • Enthusiastic and willing to learn in a fluid and fast-paced environment
  • Passionate in IT technology and wants to make a difference with technology solutions
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively at all levels
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Role Summary

The Senior Backend Engineer is a crucial position within Vingcard | ASSA ABLOY, primarily responsible for designing, developing and maintaining robust backend solutions that power our innovative access control systems for hotels and adjacent markets. The role demands a deep understanding of backend technologies, including Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Java, and Kotlin. The candidate will work in a dynamic, cross-functional team to deliver high-quality software that enhances the functionality and performance of our products.


  • Job Location: Brasilia, Brazil

KEY Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain backend applications using Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Java, and Kotlin.
  • Collaborate with frontend developers to integrate user-facing elements using server-side logic.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
  • Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle, from design to deployment.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize backend systems.
  • Ensure high performance and responsiveness of the application.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of current backend technologies and best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews, providing feedback and suggestions for improvement.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to junior developers, helping them navigate technical challenges and grow in their careers.
  • Ensure adherence to best practices in software engineering, including code quality, testing, and documentation.


Responsibilities And Authorities

  • Authority to make technical decisions related to software architecture and design.
  • Access to all necessary information and tools to perform role effectively.
  • Responsibility for delivering high-quality software solutions on time and within budget.
  • Authority to mentor and provide career development support to junior developers.
  • Reporting to the R&D Manager for project assignments and career development.


Internal and External Contacts/Customers

  • Internal: Work closely with other software developers, QA engineers, product managers, and designers.
  • External: Interact with external stakeholders during product demos or user feedback sessions.


Skills

Key competencies, Relevant Knowledge, skills and competEncies

  • Proficient in Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Experience with observability technologies (e.g. Datadog).
  • Experience with Git versioning systems.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and able to manage time effectively.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • 6+ years of professional experience in backend development.
  • Proven experience with Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC.
  • Familiarity with Git versioning systems.


Languages

  • Proficiency in English for listening, reading and writing. Intermediate speaking skills in English. Proficiency in Brazilian Portuguese.


Computer Skills

  • Proficiency in software development tools, version control systems (e.g., Git), and Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment pipelines.
  • Proficiency in Java/Kotlin.
  • Deep knowledge of Spring MVC and/or Spring Boot.
  • Proficiency in interacting with relational databases.
  • Working knowledge of distributed architectures and messaging systems (RabbitMQ, AMQP, etc).
  • Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Kubernetes, etc).


Experience

  • Software Engineer, Backend Engineer or similar position.
  • Minimum 6 years of experience.


Personal qualities

  • Strong leadership and mentorship skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a drive to take initiative and lead projects.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team.
  • Continuous improvement mindset, with a commitment to staying up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies.
  • Adaptable and eager to learn new technologies and practices.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on code quality and best practices.


Expected outcome and deliverables -(For the role, on a 3-5 years horizon)

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Backend Engineer will contribute significantly to the development and optimization of our backend systems, ensuring they are robust, scalable, and efficient. The role will play a key part in enhancing the functionality of our access control solutions, delivering high-quality software that meets the needs of our customers and stays ahead of industry trends, including launching new products. The individual in this position will have the opportunity to grow professionally, acquiring new skills and taking on additional responsibilities as part of a dynamic and innovative team.


Vingcard Athos Team

The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including IoT devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.


We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.

Our team is an integral part of the Vingcard Research & Development organization headquartered in Sweden. We are thrilled to have you join us!


CONTRACT DETAILS

  • You will be a registered employee (CLT) of ASSA ABLOY GLOBAL SOLUTIONS IMPORTACAO EXPORTACAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS ELETRONICOS LTDA.
  • Benefits include Vale Refeição.
  • Benefits include health insurance (plano de saúde) for you, your spouse and your children at no additional cost.


We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 61,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.


As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.


As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Game Operations Analyst/Senior Analyst (Graduated from 2022-2025)
description:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally.   • Fluent in Portuguese and English

Join a dynamic team where you will be directly involved in high-impact strategic projects that shape the future of our games and brand. Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.

title: BMS Commissioning Engineer
description:
BMS Commissioning Engineer - UAE


Are you a hands-on professional with a passion for precision and performance? Join us in delivering high-quality MEP systems for landmark projects in the UAE.


This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEMCO will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia


Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises


In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.


ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.


Why Join Us?

As a Commissioning Engineer, you’ll lead the commissioning of Building Management Systems (BMS) across key project sections. From planning resources to optimizing system performance, you’ll play a crucial role in ensuring high-quality installations and efficient site execution.


At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Project Planning and Controls initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences.


Your Role

  • Conduct all BMS commissioning phases: Pre-functional, Functional, and Integrated Systems Testing
  • Perform software/hardware integration with third-party systems
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system defects, supporting other trades and contractors
  • Develop, test, and commission BMS control programs based on detailed Sequences of Operation
  • Oversee Site Acceptance Tests and demonstrate systems to consultants and clients

  • Manage installation teams and day-to-day site activities, including labor, materials, and equipment

  • Proven success handling teams, budgets, and project timelines
  • Ability to work under pressure with autonomy and precision
  • Familiar with project specifications, construction drawings, and commercial coordination


What We Offer

  • Total package of salary, UAE Employment Visa, Medical Insurance & Annual ticket allowance.
  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE's most iconic projects.
  • A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.


Ready to Lead?

Join ALEMCO and shape the future of infrastructure delivery in the UAE.


Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

title: Vaga Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência - Ponta Grossa/PR
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.
